QF.id: I Codes of Conduct and Investor Protection_29

question.text: Under SEBI's ODR framework, when conciliation fails, a Market Participant wishing to challenge an arbitral award must deposit what percentage of the award amount with the MII before initiating the challenge?

answer.text: 100% of the amounts payable in terms of the arbitral award
No deposit is required — the challenge stays execution automatically

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (p.228), if a Market Participant wishes to challenge an arbitral award, it must deposit 100% of the amounts payable in terms of the arbitral award with the relevant MII prior to initiating the challenge. The Trap: 50% or 25% deposit thresholds exist in other legal contexts but not for challenging an SEBI ODR arbitral award; the framework requires the full 100%. Note: A separate 100% deposit rule applies at an earlier stage (p.226): if the Market Participant initiates online arbitration after failed conciliation, it must deposit 100% of the admissible claim value, from which up to Rs. 5 lakh may be released to the investor. That Rs. 5 lakh release applies to the pre-arbitration deposit, not to the award-challenge deposit.
